name: MonarchMessageRow
title: MessageRow
wrapsNative: HStack row with MonarchAvatar, a body ViewBuilder and .contextMenu(menuItems:) for the per-message actions; TimelineView(.everyMinute) for the relative time
summary: One message in a conversation: avatar, author, time and body, with grouped, pending, failed, edited and deleted states, reactions, a thread reply count and per-message actions in a context menu.
whenToUse: Chat channels, direct messages, threads, ticket conversations with internal notes, and comment threads, as the rows of a List or a LazyVStack.
whenNotToUse: Not for a feed of system events with verbs and objects; use MonarchActivityTimeline. Not for a notification that leads elsewhere; use MonarchNotificationCenter. Not for a conversation in an inbox list; use MonarchInboxRow.
api: init(_ author: MonarchMessageRowAuthor, time: Date, now: Date? = nil, variant: MonarchMessageRowVariant = .standard, status: MonarchMessageRowStatus = .sent, timeStyle: MonarchMessageRowTimeStyle = .relative, errorMessage: String? = nil, tags: [String] = [], reactions: [MonarchReactionBarItem] = [], replyCount: Int = 0, isGrouped: Bool = false, isEdited: Bool = false, isDeleted: Bool = false, isHighlighted: Bool = false, labels: MonarchMessageRowLabels = MonarchMessageRowLabels(), onRetry: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onDiscard: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onShowEdits: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onReactionToggle: (@MainActor (String, Bool) -> Void)? = nil, onOpenThread: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, @ViewBuilder content: () -> Content, @ViewBuilder actions: () -> Actions)

MonarchMessageRowAuthor.init(_ name: String, url: URL? = nil, seed: String? = nil)
MonarchMessageRowAuthor.init(_ name: String, image: Image?, seed: String? = nil)
enum MonarchMessageRowVariant { case standard, internal, system }
enum MonarchMessageRowStatus { case sent, pending, failed }

MonarchMessageRowLabels.init(sending: String? = nil, failed: String? = nil, retry: String? = nil, discard: String? = nil, edited: String? = nil, editHistory: String? = nil, deleted: String? = nil, replies: (@Sendable (Int) -> String)? = nil, reactions: MonarchReactionBarLabels = MonarchReactionBarLabels())

options.name: author
options.description: The name, and the avatar picture as an Image or a URL; initials otherwise.

options.name: time
options.description: When the message was sent.

options.name: now
options.description: Fixes now for the relative time. Without it the time follows the clock and updates every minute.

options.name: variant
options.description: standard, internal (warning tint and leading bar) or system (a centred caption line without avatar or author).

options.name: status
options.description: sent, pending (muted body and Sending…) or failed (error, Retry and Discard).

options.name: timeStyle
options.description: relative (5 minutes ago) or clock (14:05).

options.name: errorMessage
options.description: Why sending failed. Not sent by default.

options.name: tags
options.description: Neutral badges after the author name, such as Internal or Guest.

options.name: reactions
options.description: Emoji reactions, shown with MonarchReactionBar under the body.

options.name: replyCount
options.description: Thread replies. Shown as 1 reply or 4 replies when above zero.

options.name: isGrouped
options.description: A follow-up from the same author: the avatar and header are hidden and the body lines up with the first message.

options.name: isEdited
options.description: Shows the (edited) marker.

options.name: isDeleted
options.description: Replaces the body with This message was deleted. and hides reactions, replies and actions.

options.name: isHighlighted
options.description: Tints the row with the accent's subtle colour, for example after opening a link to the message.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for every built-in string, including the reaction bar's.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Adds Retry to a failed message.

options.name: onDiscard
options.description: Adds Discard to a failed message.

options.name: onShowEdits
options.description: Makes the edited marker a link and adds a Show edit history VoiceOver action.

options.name: onReactionToggle
options.description: Receives the emoji and the new state. Without it the reactions are read-only.

options.name: onOpenThread
options.description: Makes the reply count a link button.

options.name: content
options.description: The message body: text, attachments, link cards.

options.name: actions
options.description: Menu items shown as the row's context menu: reply, edit, copy, delete. Offered only for a sent, not deleted message.

states.name: first of a group
states.description: Avatar, bold author, tags and the time above the body.

states.name: grouped
states.description: No avatar or header; the body lines up under the first message and the row is tighter.

states.name: pending
states.description: The body is muted and Sending… is shown under it. No context menu.

states.name: failed
states.description: A danger icon and the error under the body, with Retry and Discard when given. Announced by VoiceOver. No context menu.

states.name: edited
states.description: An (edited) marker after the body, a link when the edit history can be opened.

states.name: deleted
states.description: The body is replaced by This message was deleted. in muted italics; reactions, replies and actions are hidden.

states.name: internal
states.description: A warning subtle tint with a leading bar in the warning border colour.

states.name: highlighted
states.description: An accent subtle tint, animated in and out unless Reduce Motion is on.

states.name: system
states.description: A centred muted caption with the time, without avatar, author, reactions or actions.

appearance: Author in the default text colour, time in the muted text colour and the body in the default text colour (muted while pending or deleted). Internal notes use the warning subtle fill and warning border bar; a highlight uses the accent subtle fill; a failure uses the danger strong colour with an icon. The same roles in every theme, including both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: On the web the per-message actions are a hover toolbar that also appears on focus; on iOS they are the row's context menu, which is how messages offer actions on touch. The web shows a grouped message's clock time in the gutter on hover; iOS has no hover on touch, so the gutter stays empty and the time is read by VoiceOver. The reaction bar's add button opens MonarchEmojiPicker in a sheet instead of a separate reactionAction slot. Tags are strings shown as neutral badges rather than arbitrary content, and a footer goes in the content builder. The body is a SwiftUI view, not HTML.
accessibility: The author, tags, full date and time, body, edited marker and Sending… are combined into one element.
A grouped message still begins with the author and the full date and time for VoiceOver, through an element that is not drawn.
The visible relative or clock time is replaced by the full date and time for VoiceOver.
An edited message with onShowEdits has a Show edit history VoiceOver action.
When the status becomes failed the error is announced; the error is an icon and text, and Retry and Discard are separate buttons.
Reactions use MonarchReactionBar: toggle buttons named by emoji name and count. The thread button is a separate button.
The avatar is decorative; the author is read from the header text.
Retry, Discard, the thread button and reaction chips have touch targets of at least 44 points; text wraps at every Dynamic Type size.
edgeCases: A time in the future reads as now.
Reactions whose counts are all zero hide the bar.
A failed or pending message has no context menu, so actions such as Edit cannot run on a message the server does not have.
Long author names wrap in the header with the tags and time; long bodies wrap without a line limit.
A system row ignores the author, tags, reactions, replies and actions.
